<script type="text/javascript">
            $(document).ready(function () {
                var loc = location.pathname;
                var mobilecheck = detectmob();
                var checkcookie = "false";
                var ckList = document.cookie.split("; ");
                for (var i = 0; i < ckList.length; i++) {
                    var ck = ckList[i].split("=");
                    if (ck[0] == "renew") {
                        var checkcookie = "true";
                    }
                }
                if (mobilecheck == false && checkcookie == "false" && loc != "/" && loc != "/home" && loc != "/home.aspx") {
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        $("#OfferBox").modal()
                    }, 6000);
                    document.cookie = "renew=true;path=/; 'secure'";
                }

            });

            function detectmob() {
                if (navigator.userAgent.match(/Android/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/webOS/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPad/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPod/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/BlackBerry/i)
                 || navigator.userAgent.match(/Windows Phone/i)
                 ) {
                    return true;
                }
                else {
                    return false;
                }
            }


        </script>
